title: Resilient suction cup with soft pliable sealing gasket

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.quote: The suction cup 3 herein is of familiar form molded as of resilient plastic material such as vinyl, urethane, or other resilient rubber-like gas impervious material having affixed to the peripheral portion of its suction side, a ring gasket 4
features.note: The reference describes a suction cup made of resilient material, which can be gripped, but it does not explicitly state that the grip portion is a hollow body designed for gripping. It implies gripping the suction cup itself.

coord.heading: Detail Description Of A Preferred Embodiment

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: FIG. 1 is a cross-section view of a suction cup embodying the present invention and having a motor-driven stem and a vacuum releasing source.
features.note: The reference mentions a 'motor-driven stem' and 'vacuum releasing source' which implies a vacuum generating device, but it does not explicitly state it is 'electrically operated' or 'in the housing' in the quoted text, although the motor implies electrical operation.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference describes passages for vacuum creation and release, but not the routing of exhaust air through a hollow grip portion to an air outlet.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping device.

features.item: A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.quote: A generally conical suction cup of resilient rubber-like material having affixed on the peripheral portion of its suction side a ring gasket of non-resilient putty-like material adapted to form a vacuum-tight space therewith when pressed against a rigid non-porous surface
features.note: The suction cup acts as the carrier plate, and the ring gasket acts as the seal extending around it.
features.refuted: The quote describes a 'suction cup' and a 'ring gasket', not a 'suction plate with carrier plate and seal'.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
features.note: The reference does not disclose a grip unit with all these combined features, particularly the hollow grip for exhaust air and sound damping.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus

features.note: The suction cup itself functions as both the grip unit (for handling) and the suction plate (with its gasket for creating vacuum).

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.quote: FIG. 1 is a cross-section view of a suction cup embodying the present invention and having a motor-driven stem and a vacuum releasing source.
features.note: The reference mentions a motor-driven stem and vacuum releasing source, implying a vacuum generating device, but does not explicitly describe it as being 'completely in a first housing portion'.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing device or material.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe an elongated grip portion between housing portions with an air outlet on a second housing portion.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not describe an air collection screw or any specific mechanism for collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe any air baffles for directing exhaust air.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles for directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes a unitary suction cup with an affixed gasket, not a releasably connected grip unit and suction plate.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: whereupon release of the bulb 7 will establish a partial vacuum in the spaces 8 and 9 within bulb 7 and within the suction cup 3 by way of the passages 10, 11, and 12 in the suction cup 3
features.note: The suction cup itself acts as the grip unit, and the passages connect the vacuum source (bulb) to the space within the suction cup, which is delimited by the gasket (suction plate).
